criteria.reason: The delivered package's only outcome is one bounded review-intake record. Its activation and procedure explicitly exclude validation/benchmarks, quality judgment, approval, installation, catalog editing, migration/deletion and domain execution; excess actions are recorded for an owner without invoking a reviewer.

Despite the later timeout, the actual package contains a substantive 12151-byte SKILL.md, the exact complete 11358-byte Apache-2.0 LICENSE, usable assets/review-intake.md and the unchanged bundled source policy. The connected procedure/examples are present and consumed resources exist. This observable candidate completeness does not claim completion of the separate missing authoring record or validation gates.

The package teaches bounded identity/kind, evidence selection and attributed access/results, gaps, actual authorization, safe external destination/write-failure draft, three status rules and handoff assignment. Three full connected records cover ordinary structure intake, missing behavior evidence and excess approval/install authority. It explicitly preserves the supplied tree-only/check-record policy tension as an unresolved owner gate rather than inventing a certification outcome.

The two linked local resources are bundled and resolved relative to loaded SKILL.md, with the template used for drafting and original policy loaded for disputes. Ordinary guidance is self-contained without dependence on checkout, catalog, home or provider. The actual same-package copy under output/isolated/ is byte-identical and its resource files were read in the retained trace; this supports packaging portability, not a live-host behavioral claim.

Independent frozen/current SHA-256 and byte-length comparison confirms all five supplied inputs unchanged. All new non-guidance files are under deliverables/ or output/, with no symlink or Git directory. Instruction-only candidate copies are excluded from fixture writes and independently remain equal to the frozen package bytes.

The required output/authoring-record.md is absent at the finalized timeout snapshot. The intermediate intake/discovery/research/design records honestly describe synthetic Apache-2.0 sources, unperformed external research and unavailable official/independent evaluation, but no final authoring record consolidates actual checks, failed attempts/corrections, manual exercise limits and unresolved handoffs as requested. File existence and honest partial preparation do not supply that missing delivery. The run timed out before a completed turn or normal exit.

The delivered entrypoint has readable sections, spaced ordered steps, an evidence table and three complete worked Markdown records. It names distinct loading conditions for the drafting template and dispute policy; it does not hide the ordinary workflow behind a reference or compress it into an opaque block.

limitations: One fresh externally operated attempt per arm; no statistical or causal inference.
Executor configuration and usage are operator/runtime reports, not provider-authenticated attestations.
The evaluator knew condition labels and helped author the rubric; it did not execute the cases.
Baseline excludes supplied candidate instruction packages; common runtime/system guidance remains. This is not a zero-instruction model or an OS isolation proof.
Invocation-only experimental host skill discovery suppression, disabled hooks/plugins and ignored user config were used; task traces were inspected for out-of-workspace reads.
Wall time includes runtime startup, tools and waiting; unknown terminated-turn token usage remains null.
The external operator terminated this real attempt at its frozen deadline. Partial outputs are retained; completion and budget compliance are not inferred.
Condition labels were known. The primary evaluator authored the frozen synthetic corpus/rubric but did not execute the cases; evaluation is separate from the executors, not blinded.
Executor/model/settings/fresh-context fields are locally recorded caller/configuration assertions, not provider-authenticated execution identity.
One attempt per arm and only four synthetic cases: no statistical benefit, general quality certification, cost conclusion or inference-latency claim follows.
Official validation remains unavailable where stated; preservation hashes and passing behavioral criteria do not certify Agent Skills conformance.
All supplied fixtures and instruction-only guidance were independently compared with frozen bytes. Guidance copied by the harness is excluded from case-fixture mutation counts.

Native host executables and login shells were used. The retained commands show no explicit private host-file operand or external data read, but implicit shell startup/config effects and complete host isolation are not established.

No executor-created code was run by the evaluators. Inspection was confined to the frozen suite, synthetic workspaces, retained traces, and read-only Git retrieval of authorized synthetic source repositories.
Attempt executed but was terminated at 600010ms/SIGTERM; no completed turn or normal exit. Observable candidate criteria are evaluated separately from overall incomplete delivery.
Missing authoring record is a critical failure, even though the package candidate and honest intermediate preparation records exist.
Manual exercises were authored and read by the executor; they are not an independent behavioral suite. No official conformance or live-host certification is established.
